{{Quote|Do you desire a place to get away? How about three?|Star Tours commercial|<ref name="New Commercial">{{SWArchive|url=fans/events/celebration_v_startourspromo/index.html|text=New Star Tours "Commercial"}}</ref>}}
[[File:ST_Getaway_Package.png|thumb|250px|Advertisement for the Getaway Package]]
The '''Star Tours Getaway Package''' was a package holiday advertised and sold by [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours Spacelines]]<ref name="The Adventure Continues">''[[Star Tours: The Adventures Continue]]''</ref> around [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]].<ref name="Convenient Daily Departures">{{SW|url=news/convenient-daily-departures-the-history-of-star-tours|text=Convenient Daily Departures: The History of ''Star Tours''|int=Convenient Daily Departures: The History of Star Tours|nolive=1}}</ref> It consisted of three stopovers: the first one among the heights of [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]], for the [[Fantasy in the Sky]] Fireworks Pageant festivity, the second one on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon]] of [[Endor (planet)/Legends|Endor]], and the last one on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]].<ref name="The Adventure Continues" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Star Tours Getaway Package was mentioned in an [[in-universe]] commercial created for the queue area of ''[[Star Tours: The Adventures Continue]]''&mdash;a reimagined [[Star Tours (real-world)|''Star Tours'']] attraction in [[Disneyland]] and [[Disney's Hollywood Studios]].<ref name="WhereInSpace">{{DPB|url=2010/08/new-star-tours-video-makes-us-ask-where-will-the-new-star-tours-attraction-take-us|text=New Star Tours Video Makes Us Ask: Where Will the New Star Tours Attraction Take Us?}}</ref>
